---

The function has been simplified to extract text content without complex parsing. It now:

1. First tries to get the direct `text` field from the metadata
2. If not available, tries the `context` field
3. If still not available and `_node_content` exists:
   - Tries to extract just the "text" field from the JSON if it exists
   - If no text field or if parsing fails, simply uses the entire `_node_content` string as the text

This simpler approach should ensure that the full content is always extracted, even when the structure is complex or unexpected.
